summary.text: Heather Baxter is the Republican nominee. A Rapid City small-business owner and state representative, she lost her June 2 House primary and won the secretary of state nomination at the Republican convention. She supports hand-counted paper ballots and improved audits, and co-sponsored a bill to prohibit automatic tabulating machines; she says that as secretary of state she would work with county auditors rather than eliminate machines on her own.

paragraphs.text: Small-business owner in Rapid City and Custer; has also worked as a strength and flexibility coach for older adults.
Member of the Pennington County Republican executive board.
Elected to the South Dakota House in 2024; lost her June 2, 2026 Republican primary for re-election.
